title: BC U205: Use of Manufactured Homes as ADUs
officialText:
U205.1 Scope.

Where a manufactured home is permitted by this code, the manufactured home may be used as an ADU in accordance with Section U103, U203, U204, and rules of the department.

(L.L. 2024/127, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
